errors.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
errors.genericBody: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.forbiddenBody: Your role does not have permission to view this section.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.subtitle: Conversations with your contacts across all channels.
conversations.emptyHint: When a contact writes in, it will show up here.

reply.hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter for a new line · “/” searches quick replies. Replying takes over the conversation and the bot stops answering.
reply.unresolved: Check the text: data is missing for {vars}.
reply.closed: This conversation is closed and no longer accepts replies.
reply.assignedToOther: Another team member is handling this conversation.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.subtitle: The people who get in touch with your business.
contacts.emptyHint: Contacts are created automatically when someone writes in, or you can add one.
contacts.notePlaceholder: Write a note for your team…

documents.title: Knowledge base
documents.subtitle: The documents the assistant uses to answer your customers.
documents.dropzoneTitle: Drag files or click to choose
documents.dropzoneHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, XLSX or images · up to {max}
documents.deleteBody: “{title}” and its chunks will no longer be used in answers. This cannot be undone.
documents.emptyHint: Upload documents so the assistant can answer with your information.

quickReplies.title: Quick replies
quickReplies.subtitle: Predefined messages your team can send with a shortcut.
quickReplies.emptyHint: Create the first one to reply faster.
quickReplies.shortcutFormat: Must start with / and use only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore (e.g. /greeting)
quickReplies.variablesHint: Available variables: '{{contact_name}}', '{{agent_name}}', '{{ticket_id}}' and '{{date}}'; they are filled in when sending.
quickReplies.deleteBody: “{title}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: How you want to see the app. They are saved to your account.
preferences.languageHint: The language of the app's menus and texts.
preferences.themeHint: Light, dark, or whatever your device uses.

flags.title: Tenant features
flags.subtitle: Turn features of your account on or off.

sandbox.title: Sandbox & features
sandbox.subtitle: Try assistant changes without affecting your customers, and publish them when ready.
sandbox.disabledBody: Ask the platform operator to enable the “enable_sandbox” feature for your account.
sandbox.noneTitle: You don't have a sandbox yet
sandbox.noneBody: A copy of your assistant's configuration will be created so you can test safely.

done.rollback: Production rolled back to the previous version

reset.title: Reset the sandbox
reset.body: Sandbox changes and test conversations will be lost and your production configuration will be copied again.

publish.title: Publish to production
publish.body: The sandbox configuration will go to production and your customers will see it. The current version is saved so you can roll back.

rollback.title: Roll back to the previous version
rollback.body: Production will get back the last saved configuration. What is live now is saved as another version.

sandbox.tryHint: Messages go to the sandbox assistant and are sent to no one. They use tokens from your testing quota.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.subtitle: A quick look at your account's activity.
dashboard.quickStartHint: Shortcuts to the most common tasks.
dashboard.responseTimeHint: By the bot or a person, last 7 days
dashboard.noConversations: No conversations in this period yet.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: The people who use the platform in your account, and their role.
team.newPasswordHint: Leave it empty to keep the current one. The person will use it the next time they sign in.
team.selfRoleHint: You cannot change your own role; ask another administrator.
team.deactivateBody: {name} will no longer be able to sign in or renew their session. If already signed in, access keeps working for a few minutes.
team.reactivateBody: {name} will be able to sign in again.

businessProfile.title: Business profile
businessProfile.subtitle: Your business details, hours and brand.
businessProfile.usageNotice: Today the assistant only uses the two messages in the “Assistant” section. The rest is stored for the features that will read it (out of hours, widget, panel branding) and does not change its behavior yet.

fields.handoff_message: Message when handing over to a person

hints.logo: An https link to an image. File upload will arrive once storage is configured.

businessProfile.assistantHint: What the assistant says when opening a conversation and when handing it to a person.
businessProfile.noAgent: Your account has no active assistant yet, so these messages cannot be saved.

errors.handle: Letters, numbers, dot and underscore only
